This maize plot is small but important for my family's food. I've been farming for many years, and I know maize needs fertilizer to give a good yield, so I will buy some DAP and urea from the cooperative like I do every season, though I cannot afford the full recommended amount. I also spread manure from my animals on this plot before ploughing because it helps the soil. I will use my own saved seed as I have done before — the improved seed costs too much and I trust my variety. My sons and I will do all the work ourselves; the plot is small, no need to hire anyone.
